messages:
Sam R.: flagging a product/ops tradeoff thread: we've had multiple asks for "burst without surprise bills" from large customers. I sketched two approaches: credit-pool (post-pay credits) vs precommit unlock (contract required). want input on launch criteria and billing UX.

Priya M.: keen. what's the behavioral delta between the two?

Sam R.: credit-pool: each tenant gets a small free-burst allowance (e.g., 10% of committed GPUs per month). During burst_window we allow allocation beyond committed capacity up to allowance. Charges are applied once allowance exhausted. Precommit-unlock: customer must add a "burst addendum" to contract to enable burst; no surprise charges because it's explicit.

Leo K.: ops perspective: credit accounting is straightforward but forecasting pain. Precommit reduces risk but adds sales friction. Also precommit lets us enforce limits server-side.

Nora T.: Legal: precommit helps with SLAs and clear obligations. Credits could work if we add explicit invoice lines and monthly reconciliation. BigBank prefers contract-first.

Autoscale Bot: sim-run:trace-2026-03-20 -> credit-policy with default 10% allowance: p95 increase during extreme spike = 0.9s; average additional GPU-hours billed per spike = 3.2. precommit-policy -> p95 increase = 0.4s; billed extra = 0 (locked but immediate allocate prevented).

Sam R.: API/UI implications: need per-pool fields and an account-level contract flag. sample API snippet: 
```json
{
  "pool_id": "p-001",
  "autoscale": {
    "smoothing": "gradual",
    "ramp_window_sec": 45,
    "burst_window_sec": 300,
    "free_burst_pct": 10
  },
  "contract": {
    "burst_enabled": false,
    "burst_tier": "standard"
  }
}
```

Priya M.: for UX we should show current free_burst_balance in Console and in billing preview. also add a warning modal when a spike will consume >50% of allowance.

Leo K.: rollout & safety: proposal:
- canary 1% of pools with opt-in
- canary metrics: scale_latency_p95, requests_failed_during_scale, gpu_delta_rate, billing_delta_estimate
- kill-switch to disable smoothing globally and per-pool
- emergency fast-path for enterprise contracts (one immediate allocation per pool per 24h)

Nora T.: contract language stub: "Customer may opt into burst capability subject to agreed allowance. Burst usage beyond allowance will be billed as overage unless Customer subscribes to burst precommit tier." Legal wants this in pilot offer doc.

Sam R.: launch checklist draft:
- [ ] sims across 4 workload shapes (steady, ramp, short-spike, long-spike) with both policies
- [ ] per-pool API + Console fields implemented
- [ ] billing line item and CSV export for burst events
- [ ] contract text for precommit + pilot agreement for BigBank
- [ ] runbook for ops with kill-switch steps and monitoring runbook
- [ ] canary monitoring dashboard and alert thresholds

Priya M.: metrics detail: record per-scale window: baseline_qps, queued_requests, added_gpus, latency_delta_p50/p95, burst_allowance_consumed. expose via metrics API for customers.

Leo K.: on-call note: add automation to auto-revert smoothing for pools where failed_requests > X over Y minutes. need a manual override in console.

Sam R.: decision points we need by EOD Fri to hit April pilot:
1) default policy (credit-pool vs precommit)
2) default free_burst_pct and ramp_window_sec
3) canary size

Nora T.: legal leaning: precommit for enterprise pilots; credits ok for self-serve smaller customers.

Priya M.: propose defaults: free_burst_pct=10 for self-serve, ramp_window_sec=60, canary=1% initially. that matches sims?

Autoscale Bot: scheduled-sim-#489 results: self-serve default sim -> spike p95 delta=1.0s, median scale time=52s. enterprise precommit sim -> spike p95 delta=0.45s, median scale time=28s (fast-path enabled).

Leo K.: ops OK with Priya defaults if precommit path is mandatory for enterprise SLA customers. need clear Sales checklist.

Sam R.: action items: Priya to design Console burst balance UI + billing preview, Leo to add rollback automation and canary run plan, Nora to prepare pilot contract text, I'll finalize the decision doc and sync Sales. will move to PRD once we have sign-off.

Priya M.: starting UI mockups now, will post in #design by EOD.

Nora T.: pinging Sales for BigBank approval.

Autoscale Bot: reminder: runbook-template v2 uploaded to /internal/runbooks/autoscale.json

Sam R.: thanks team. will collect sims and vendor feedback, follow up with a concrete launch timeline.
